title: Whole-Genome DNA Extractions for MinION Sequencing Using the Macherey-Nagel NucleoBond HMW DNA Kit
author: Stephanie Le Prieur
materials: Discard the flow-through and the column filter.
Quality control using Nanodrop, Qubit and agarose gels.

steps.title: Culture and Prepare Mycelium
steps.instruction: Grow strains on PDA medium and prepare lyophilized powder.

substeps.instruction: Grow strains on Petri dishes with PDA medium for 4 days at 20 °C.
Scrape plates into 2 mL Eppendorf tubes and store at –80 °C for at least 24 h.
Lyophilize for 2 days (tube opened and sealed with pierced parafilm).

steps.title: Grind and Weigh Sample
steps.instruction: Mechanically grind the mycelium and weigh the required amount.

substeps.instruction: Grind lyophilized mycelium using the Retsch grinder and metal beads for 40 sec × 2 at 30 Hz until the powder is fine.
Weigh out 250 mg of dried mycelium for DNA extraction.

steps.title: Initial Lysis
steps.instruction: Perform initial lysis and centrifugation of the sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 900 µL of lysis buffer H1 and 200 µL proteinase K to each sample.
Vortex for 2 min.
Centrifuge for 2 min at 11,000 G.

steps.title: Secondary Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Further lyse the sample and incubate to break down cellular structures.

substeps.instruction: Transfer sample to a 15 mL tube and add 4 mL of buffer H1.
Aliquot the sample into three 2 mL microtubes and vortex for 5 sec.
Incubate samples at 50 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: RNA Removal
steps.instruction: Remove RNA from the combined sample.

substeps.instruction: Combine the aliquots back into one new 15 mL polypropylene, conical centrifuge tube.
Add 100 µL RNase A.
Mix gently by inverting the tube and incubate for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Column Equilibration
steps.instruction: Prepare the NucleoBond HMW column for loading.

substeps.instruction: Place the NucleoBond HMW column on a 50 mL tube using the manufacturer's plastic rings.
Equilibrate with 12 mL buffer H2 by pouring along the sides of the filter (not at the center!).
Let it drain by gravity.

steps.title: DNA Binding and Washing
steps.instruction: Load the sample onto the column and wash to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL buffer H2 to each sample tube and mix gently by inversion.
Load the sample onto the center of the column and let it flow through by gravity.
Add 6 mL buffer H3 to the column (along the sides!) and let it flow through.
Wash the column (without filter) with 12 mL buffer H4.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Place the column on new 50 mL tubes for DNA elution.
Add 5 mL of elution buffer H5.

steps.title: DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate and collect the DNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Add 3.5 mL isopropanol to each eluate and mix gently by inversion 10 times until a DNA pellet appears.
Centrifuge for 10 min at 4,500 g.
Carefully discard the supernatant by pipetting without losing the DNA pellet.

steps.title: Pellet Washing and Drying
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet and dry it before resuspension.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL of 70% ethanol (0.22 µM filter-sterilized) to each DNA pellet.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 4,500 g.
Dry the pellet at room temperature, ensuring no ethanol remains but avoiding over-drying.

steps.title: DNA Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final DNA pellet in buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA in 150 µL HE buffer by flicking the tube or gently pipetting the pellet using wide-bore tips.
Transfer the DNA to a 1.5 mL microtube.
If the liquid is still cloudy, add 50–100 µL (or more) HE buffer.
